lines.zh: 我的布腿一拐一拐，像被孩子拖着走。
lines.en: My cloth legs limp along as if a child drags me.

lines.zh: 弹簧从脚底顶出来，我一步一弹。
lines.en: A spring pushes from my sole, and I bounce with each step.

lines.zh: 棉花在缝线里挤来挤去，走得很响。
lines.en: The stuffing shifts inside my seams and rustles as I walk.

lines.zh: 玩具维度没有路，只有积木和我的脚印。
lines.en: The Toy dimension has no roads, only blocks and my footprints.

lines.zh: 我踩过彩色的地板，留下一道灰线。
lines.en: I cross the colored floor and leave a gray line.

lines.zh: 别看我圆，走过来只要三秒。
lines.en: Do not let my round shape fool you; I close in three seconds.

lines.zh: 我的影子比身体长，像一根棍子。
lines.en: My shadow is longer than my body, like a stick.

lines.zh: 走一步，缝线就松一针。
lines.en: Every step loosens one stitch along my side.

lines.zh: 我从玩具箱那头一路挪过来。
lines.en: I have shuffled all the way from the toy chest.

lines.zh: 布鞋磨破了，里面还是布。
lines.en: My cloth shoes wore through; inside is more cloth.

lines.zh: 这条腿认识你，它自己拐了过来。
lines.en: This leg remembers you and turns toward you on its own.

lines.zh: 九十五点生命，我不轻易后退。
lines.en: With ninety-five points of life, I rarely step back.

lines.zh: 我坐着，等哪个孩子来拧我的发条。
lines.en: I sit and wait for some child to wind my key.

lines.zh: 线头翘起来了，我按回去。
lines.en: A thread end pops up; I press it back down.

lines.zh: 玩具维度很安静，只有棉花在响。
lines.en: The Toy dimension is quiet; only my stuffing makes noise.

lines.zh: 我记得被抱过，记不清是谁。
lines.en: I remember being held; I cannot recall by whom.

lines.zh: 我的扣子眼盯着前面，一眨不眨。
lines.en: My button eyes stare ahead without ever blinking.

lines.zh: 九十五点生命，全缝在这层布里。
lines.en: Ninety-five points of life, all sewn into this cloth.

lines.zh: 没有心跳，可我还是觉得闷。
lines.en: I have no heartbeat, yet I still feel stifled.

lines.zh: 我在数地板的格子，数到第七块。
lines.en: I am counting floor tiles and have reached the seventh.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我就轻轻晃，像还挂着。
lines.en: When wind blows, I sway as if still hanging on a hook.

lines.zh: 有人在远处笑，我抬起了头。
lines.en: Someone laughs far away, and I lift my head.

lines.zh: 你比货架上的娃娃好看一点。
lines.en: You look a little better than the dolls on the shelf.

lines.zh: 我在看你手上有没有绳子。
lines.en: I am checking whether you carry a string.

lines.zh: 你的脸很软，捏一下会怎样。
lines.en: Your face looks soft; what happens if I squeeze it?

lines.zh: 你身上有外面的灰，我闻得到。
lines.en: You carry outside dust; I can smell it on you.

lines.zh: 别移开视线，我正在认你。
lines.en: Hold still; I am learning your face by heart.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是扣子，只能看一个方向。
lines.en: My eyes are buttons and only face one way.

lines.zh: 你站得那么直，线会绷断的。
lines.en: You stand so straight your threads would snap.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里看见了自己的倒影。
lines.en: I see my own reflection inside your eyes.

lines.zh: 你不是孩子，那就不用客气了。
lines.en: You are not a child, so I need no manners.

lines.zh: 看够了吗？我可一直看着你。
lines.en: Seen enough? I have been watching you the whole time.

lines.zh: 破了，棉花从口子里往外冒。
lines.en: I am torn, and stuffing pushes out of the gap.

lines.zh: 你砍断了一根线，还有几百根。
lines.en: You cut one thread; hundreds remain.

lines.zh: 我不喊疼，我只会更用力。
lines.en: I do not cry out; I only push harder.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的脸打歪了。
lines.en: That blow knocked my face crooked.

lines.zh: 布破了可以补，别得意。
lines.en: Cloth can be mended, so do not gloat.

lines.zh: 我听见自己里面有什么断了。
lines.en: I hear something inside me snap.

lines.zh: 你打中的是旧补丁，那里最薄。
lines.en: You struck an old patch, the thinnest spot.

lines.zh: 疼是不疼，就是有点空。
lines.en: It does not hurt; it just feels hollow.

lines.zh: 我退半步，不是怕，是站稳。
lines.en: I step back half a pace to steady myself, not from fear.

lines.zh: 再来，我的线还够用。
lines.en: Again; I still have thread to spare.

lines.zh: 玩具不吃东西，塞进去会漏。
lines.en: Toys do not eat; it would leak out of me.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，我只要你的注意力。
lines.en: Put that away; I only want your attention.

lines.zh: 糖？玩具维度的糖是木头做的。
lines.en: Candy? In the Toy dimension candy is carved from wood.

lines.zh: 你把面包举高，我就当没看见。
lines.en: You raise the bread high; I pretend not to notice.

lines.zh: 我肚子里只有棉花，没有胃。
lines.en: There is only stuffing in me, no stomach.

lines.zh: 喂我一颗苹果，缝线会染色。
lines.en: Feed me an apple and my seams will stain.

lines.zh: 别拿食物哄我，我又不是狗。
lines.en: Do not coax me with food; I am not a dog.

lines.zh: 那味道飘过来，我有点想咬。
lines.en: That smell drifts over and I half want to bite.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，比食物好玩。
lines.en: The thing in your hand is more fun than food.

lines.zh: 我饿了很久，可我不知道饿什么。
lines.en: I have been hungry long, yet I cannot name the hunger.

lines.zh: 撞上来吧，我里面全是软的。
lines.en: Bump into me; everything inside me is soft.

lines.zh: 你推我，我就整块倒下去。
lines.en: Push me and I topple over as one whole piece.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，缝线响了。
lines.en: We collide and my stitching creaks aloud.

lines.zh: 别踩我的脚，那是两块布。
lines.en: Do not step on my feet; they are just two cloth pads.

lines.zh: 你比我重，可我不怕压。
lines.en: You are heavier, but I do not mind being crushed.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我半边脸瘪了。
lines.en: That bump dented half of my face inward.

lines.zh: 我贴着你，像挂在衣架上。
lines.en: I press against you like a coat on a rack.

lines.zh: 后退点，我的弹簧夹住你了。
lines.en: Back off; my spring has caught your leg.

lines.zh: 撞我也不疼，我早就没知觉。
lines.en: Hitting me does not hurt; I lost feeling long ago.

lines.zh: 你撞过来的时候，我听见线断。
lines.en: When you crashed in, I heard a thread snap.

lines.zh: 玩具不会配对，我们只被摆在一起。
lines.en: Toys do not pair; we are merely shelved together.

lines.zh: 我没有伴，只有一排同样的我。
lines.en: I have no partner, only a row of identical me.

lines.zh: 线把我缝成单个的，拆不开。
lines.en: The thread sewed me single; I cannot be split.

lines.zh: 别找我的另一半，它没被做出来。
lines.en: Do not seek my other half; it was never made.

lines.zh: 玩具维度的婚礼都是摆拍。
lines.en: Weddings in the Toy dimension are only posed photos.

lines.zh: 我连性别都是画上去的。
lines.en: Even my gender was painted on afterward.

lines.zh: 我抱过别的娃娃，那不算亲近。
lines.en: I have hugged other dolls; that does not count as closeness.

lines.zh: 两个人偶靠一起，也还是两件货。
lines.en: Two dolls leaning together are still two goods.

lines.zh: 我不繁殖，我只被复制。
lines.en: I do not breed; I am only duplicated.

lines.zh: 你问这个，是把我当成活的了？
lines.en: You ask that as if I were truly alive?

lines.zh: 捡起来塞进胸口，谁也看不见。
lines.en: I pick it up and stuff it in my chest where none can see.

lines.zh: 这东西能缝在我手上吗？
lines.en: Can this be sewn onto my hand?

lines.zh: 我捡了块木头，当成新手指。
lines.en: I picked up wood and treat it as a new finger.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，都是没人要的。
lines.en: Whatever falls to the ground was unwanted anyway.

lines.zh: 我口袋里有个洞，捡了也会掉。
lines.en: There is a hole in my pocket, so pickups fall through.

lines.zh: 这块亮亮的，归我了。
lines.en: This bright little thing is mine now.

lines.zh: 捡东西不用手，用整只袖子。
lines.en: I do not pick things up with hands, but with a whole sleeve.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进棉花里，藏好了。
lines.en: I tucked it into the stuffing, safely hidden.

lines.zh: 你掉了什么？我只看见布。
lines.en: What did you drop? I only see cloth.

lines.zh: 捡起来容易，放回去难。
lines.en: Picking it up is easy; putting it back is hard.

lines.zh: 你动了，我的头就跟着转。
lines.en: You moved, and my head turned with you.

lines.zh: 找到你了，就在积木后面。
lines.en: Found you, right behind the building blocks.

lines.zh: 九十五点生命，够我走到你面前。
lines.en: Ninety-five points of life is enough to reach you.

lines.zh: 我不出声，脚步已经朝你去了。
lines.en: I make no sound, but my feet already turn.

lines.zh: 你踩响地板那一刻，我就知道了。
lines.en: The moment you creaked the floor, I knew.

lines.zh: 新的目标，旧的缝线，一样紧。
lines.en: New target, old stitches, pulled equally tight.

lines.zh: 这次我们不玩捉迷藏。
lines.en: This time we are not playing hide and seek.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，把方向指给我了。
lines.en: Your smell points the direction out to me.

lines.zh: 我从货架这头看见你了。
lines.en: I spotted you from this end of the shelf.

lines.zh: 目标确认，我的弹簧绷紧了。
lines.en: Target confirmed; my spring winds tight.

lines.zh: 你跑吧，我认得你的脚步声。
lines.en: Run if you like; I know your footsteps.

lines.zh: 我盯上的人，从没被玩具放过。
lines.en: No one I have marked was ever spared by a toy.

lines.zh: 九点伤害，正好够你记住我。
lines.en: Nine points of damage is just enough to remember me.

lines.zh: 别躲了，我的扣子眼锁住你了。
lines.en: Stop hiding; my button eyes have you locked.

lines.zh: 积木倒了，是你在后面。
lines.en: The blocks fell, so you're behind them.

lines.zh: 这一片地板只留着你的脚印。
lines.en: Yours are the only footprints on this floor.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼近，布鞋蹭着地。
lines.en: I close in step by step, cloth shoes scraping.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，我就停在一步外。
lines.en: You back into a corner and I stop one step away.

lines.zh: 我的手臂抬起来了，很慢，但很稳。
lines.en: My arm rises, slow but perfectly steady.

lines.zh: 数到三，我就扑过去。
lines.en: I will lunge when I finish counting to three.

lines.zh: 你喘得越来越急，我听见了。
lines.en: I hear your breath slipping out of rhythm.

lines.zh: 别看我圆，我压下来很沉。
lines.en: Do not mistake my roundness; I fall heavily.

lines.zh: 你先眨眼，我就动。
lines.en: Blink first, and I will move.

lines.zh: 这一拳缝了三十年才缝好。
lines.en: This fist took thirty years of stitching to finish.

lines.zh: 你手里的剑，比我见过的针粗。
lines.en: The sword in your hand is thicker than any needle I know.

lines.zh: 我不急，玩具最会等。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; toys are best at waiting.

lines.zh: 再近半步，我就够到你了。
lines.en: Half a step closer and I will reach you.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经压在你脚上。
lines.en: My shadow already lies across your feet.

lines.zh: 现在转身，我不会追太远。
lines.en: Turn around now and I will not chase far.

lines.zh: 我把你圈在积木中间了。
lines.en: I have boxed you in among the building blocks.

lines.zh: 我把头歪过去，扣子对准你。
lines.en: I tilt my head and aim my button at you.

lines.zh: 你后面没路了，只有墙。
lines.en: There's no way behind you, only wall.

lines.zh: 我数到二了，你还不跑。
lines.en: I'm at two, and you still haven't run.

lines.zh: 玩具的耐心比线还长。
lines.en: A toy's patience is longer than its thread.

lines.zh: 你一举手，我就知道方向。
lines.en: Raise a hand and I know the direction.

lines.zh: 我把你挡在货架和门之间。
lines.en: I've got you between the shelf and the door.

lines.zh: 这一掌下去，你的骨头会响。
lines.en: This palm lands, and your bones will answer.

lines.zh: 九点伤害，不多，够疼。
lines.en: Nine points of damage: not much, but enough to hurt.

lines.zh: 我打你一下，缝线松了一半。
lines.en: I hit you once and half my stitching comes loose.

lines.zh: 别挡，我的拳头是实心布。
lines.en: Do not block; my fist is solid-packed cloth.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我就补上半步。
lines.en: Half a step back and I fill the gap.

lines.zh: 我的手打歪了，脸却撞上你。
lines.en: My hand missed, but my face struck you.

lines.zh: 这一下是替被丢掉的娃娃打的。
lines.en: This blow is for every doll that was thrown away.

lines.zh: 疼吗？我不知道疼是什么。
lines.en: Does it hurt? I have no idea what hurting is.

lines.zh: 你身上的护甲，缝得没我密。
lines.en: Your armor is not stitched as densely as I am.

lines.zh: 我又抬起手了，别以为结束了。
lines.en: My hand is up again; do not think it is over.

lines.zh: 打中你的那声闷响，真好听。
lines.en: The dull sound of hitting you is genuinely pleasant.

lines.zh: 我的力气全在棉花压紧的地方。
lines.en: My strength lives where the stuffing is packed tight.

lines.zh: 你再挨两下，就该坐下了。
lines.en: Two more of these and you will be sitting down.

lines.zh: 我不停手，玩具不会累。
lines.en: I do not stop; toys do not get tired.

lines.zh: 我的手落下来，地板闷了一声。
lines.en: My hand comes down and the floor thuds.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你的护甲凹了。
lines.en: This hit dents your armor.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，你的呼吸乱了。
lines.en: We collide, and your breathing breaks rhythm.

lines.zh: 缝线没断，我还能接着打。
lines.en: The stitching holds, so I keep swinging.

lines.zh: 你的剑划过棉花，没什么感觉。
lines.en: Your sword cuts through cotton and I feel little.

lines.zh: 第二拳砸下去，玩具地板都陷了。
lines.en: My second punch sinks the toy floor.

lines.zh: 我从玩具箱里被倒出来了。
lines.en: I was dumped out of the toy chest.

lines.zh: 缝线自己收紧，我就站起来了。
lines.en: The stitching tightened itself, and I stood up.

lines.zh: 这里的地板是彩色的，我认得。
lines.en: This floor is colored, and I recognize it.

lines.zh: 谁把我摆在这儿？我懒得问。
lines.en: Who set me here? I cannot be bothered to ask.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，扣子就对准了路。
lines.en: I opened my eyes and the buttons aimed down the path.

lines.zh: 玩具维度又多了一件会走的东西。
lines.en: The Toy dimension gained one more walking thing.

lines.zh: 我落地时没声音，棉花吸掉了。
lines.en: I landed silently; the stuffing swallowed the sound.

lines.zh: 刚缝好的身体，还带着线头。
lines.en: My freshly sewn body still trails loose thread.

lines.zh: 我从架子上掉下来，就醒了。
lines.en: I fell off the shelf, and that woke me.

lines.zh: 有人笑了一声，然后我出现了。
lines.en: Someone laughed once, and then I appeared.

lines.zh: 这里比箱子里亮，也冷。
lines.en: This place is brighter than the chest, and colder.

lines.zh: 我的影子一落地，就开始找目标。
lines.en: The instant my shadow landed, I began hunting.

lines.zh: 我的布一烧就卷，别点我。
lines.en: My cloth curls when burned; do not set me alight.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，棉花先着地。
lines.en: When I fall, the stuffing lands first.

lines.zh: 布吸了水，我沉得走不动。
lines.en: The cloth soaks water and I sink too heavy to walk.

lines.zh: 炸开的线头，飞得满街都是。
lines.en: Blown thread ends scatter across the whole street.

lines.zh: 箭插在棉花里，像根粗针。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my stuffing like a thick needle.

lines.zh: 药水味钻进缝线，我发麻。
lines.en: The potion smell seeps into my seams and numbs me.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿只是空想。
lines.en: I eat nothing, so hunger is only an idea.

lines.zh: 雷穿过来，每一针都白了。
lines.en: The bolt runs through me; every stitch glows white.

lines.zh: 虚空把我拆回一堆线和布。
lines.en: The void takes me apart into thread and cloth.
